description: github>plurano/horistes: the family preset holds the shared values (recommended base, sign-off, three days of waiting after a release, no merge by the bot); this file keeps only what is this repository's own.
helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests: every action stays pinned to a commit, with the version in the comment beside it.

packageRules.description: Generated devcontainer files: the Praetor engine renders them and its audit refuses an edit, so no update is proposed for them.
praetor-managed files: praetorctl adopt ships their updates and praetorctl audit locks them byte for byte

Go toolchain: the toolchain directive of go.mod and the golang builder image of the Dockerfile move in one pull request, because the Dockerfile stops a build whose builder Go differs from the directive. Vulnerability updates are not grouped by Renovate (vulnerabilityAlerts sets groupName null); for those the Dockerfile check still refuses a mismatch.
Go toolchain: the golang builder image joins the group of the toolchain directive (rule above).
